title: Interactive Geo-Tier Routing Heuristics: Console Editor + Validator
creator: Evan Brooks
description: Deliver a first-class, customer-configurable policy editor in Console that lets operators author geography-aware and tier-sensitive routing heuristics and preview their runtime effects. The editor should support: 1) region selection rules (e.g., prefer eu-west over us-east for GDPR customers), 2) tier routing (route premium traffic to 'dedicated' before 'hosted'), and 3) explicit fallback model-variant chains with constraints (latency, cost, token-limit). This ticket covers the PM spec, acceptance criteria, and coordination with Design and Engineering to prototype a validation and preview pipeline that runs lightweight simulations against synthetic traces.
acceptance_criteria: Console editor UI where users can create multiple ordered rules: region match -> tier preference -> model-variant fallback
Validation engine flags unreachable fallbacks, overlapping region rules, and circular model-variant references before save
Preview pane shows simulated request traces (latency, estimated cost, chosen model variant) for a provided sample set of user requests
Suggested auto-fixes: merge overlapping region rules and recommend model variants when latency or token limits are exceeded
Telemetry emitted for policy evaluation time and rejections for SLO monitoring (traceable via Console Observability tab)
tasks: Write PM spec and gating criteria (this ticket)
Design mockups: rule list, condition builder, preview timeline, validation panel
Engineering: validation engine API + preview simulator service
Create synthetic trace generator and sample corpora for common customer patterns
Integrate validation results into save workflow with explanatory messages
End-to-end QA with Dedicated/Hosted sample deployments
Docs: Console how-to + example policies and troubleshooting guide
updates: 2026-03-01 - Kickoff: scoped initial MVP to Console editor + basic validator. Attendees: Evan (PM), Lina Park (Design), Marco Ruiz (Eng infra), Jordan Patel (Runtime). Action: Design to produce 2 flows by 2026-03-05.

2026-03-06 - Eng architect note (Marco Ruiz): Validation needs to run synchronously in save path for most errors (cyclic rules) but run asynchronously for heavy simulations. Trade-off documented in spec: synchronous checks for structural correctness; async for cost/latency projections.
2026-03-07 - PM updated acceptance criteria to require 'auto-fix suggestions' for overlapping region matches (example heuristics added).

2026-03-08 - Proto PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/2147 (validation API + UI hooks). Reviewer: Jordan Patel. Initial comments: add idempotency to validation endpoint and limit default simulation window to 500 traces.
2026-03-09 - Security review triage: team recommended review for KMS interactions if preview uses real customer telemetry. security_review_required set to true and flagged for S&P team follow-up.

2026-03-11 - Design critique: UX should expose 'policy precedence' visually and allow drag-to-reorder. Lina to supply microcopy for failure messages. Updated mocks in Drive: https://drive.redwood.ai/designs/geo-tier-editor/v2

Scoped perf optimization for kernel scheduling to reduce 95th to <80ms for save path. Linked PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/console/pull/2189
